original_test_intent: Verify the approved AGFHC installation and run its PCIe link-status check across every expected AMD GPU, proving each mapped device reports success and produces no new relevant kernel/AGFHC error evidence.
original_method: Pin AGFHC/ROCm/driver versions and archive checksum; build an expected GPU serial/UUID/BDF/root-port/link matrix; record a start marker rather than clearing logs; run -h and preserve version/usage; run exactly one pcie_link_status subtest with timeout; capture stdout/stderr/exit and per-GPU results; compare capable/current width/speed and inspect bounded dmesg/AGFHC logs for new errors.
manual_activity: Engineer approves signed AGFHC build, expected all-GPU topology/link attributes and log-error policy.
safety_requirements: Stop on GPU disappearance, link downgrade, AER/RAS or hang
agent_execution_scope: Run help and one approved read-oriented check

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Broadly correct but incomplete without the literal subtest, all-device identity and log-window rules.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run `/opt/amd/agfhc/agfhc -h` then `/opt/amd/agfhc/agfhc -t pcie_link_status` under timeout, retaining complete output, return code and bounded kernel-log delta.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: -h, -t pcie_link_status, all GPUs, Success/FAIL and dmesg_test.log condition retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Join AGFHC per-device results to a stable GPU/BDF/root-port matrix and independently verify negotiated link attributes and new log evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds provenance, exact identity, timeout and non-destructive log delimiting.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A global Success token cannot prove every expected GPU was checked at the correct link state.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Index ordering can change, and a tool may omit a missing GPU; only identity-based expected-versus-observed comparison closes that gap.

project_override_considerations: Owner defines expected GPU count/BDFs/link width/speed, permitted recovery/downtraining, meaningful dmesg patterns and whether AGFHC output exposes per-GPU coverage.
expected_evidence: Per-GPU link results and independent inventory
